hypothesis: Multi-scale convolutional neural network ensemble trained on all 437 GeoDAWN bands will achieve >0.25 HOLDOUT-DTI by capturing fault expressions at multiple resolutions (regional lineaments to local scarps), significantly outperforming the current repository best of 0.18478 (H77E-ACD).
mechanism: EfficientNetV2-S backbone with atrous spatial pyramid pooling captures multi-scale fault signatures. Multi-scale feature fusion (100m, 200m, 400m resolutions) enables detection of faults visible at any scale. End-to-end deep learning learns optimal non-linear combinations of magnetic, radiometric, and topographic indicators.
named_non_fault_mimic: Non-tectonic lineaments (Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Lake Bonneville shorelines, roads, rivers, dunes) that appear as linear features at single scales but lack multi-scale consistency.
mimic_mitigation: Multi-scale consistency check (true faults appear at multiple scales), geological context (alignment with regional stress fields), morphological filtering (fault-specific width and continuity).
layers_involved: Magnetic: TMI, RTP, vertical derivative, analytic signal, tilt derivative, etc.
Radiometric: K, Th, U, total count, K/Th, U/Th, U/K ratios
DEM: Elevation, slope, aspect, profile curvature, plan curvature, hillshade
Derived: Tilt angle, local relief, roughness, topographic position index
physical_signature: Faults express as: (1) Regional scale - linear magnetic/gravity anomalies (1000s m); (2) Intermediate scale - topographic steps and scarps (100s m); (3) Local scale - individual fault strands (10s m). Multi-scale CNN captures all three simultaneously.
why_catches_missing_faults: Traditional methods operate at single scales (e.g., step detection at 100m, curvature at 200m). Many blind faults are only visible at specific scales. Multi-scale CNN ensemble detects faults at ANY scale, including those missed by single-scale methods.
differentiation_from_repository: Repository uses hand-crafted features + traditional ML (LightGBM, HGB) at single scales. H85 uses end-to-end deep learning with automatic multi-scale feature extraction. No repository lane uses CNNs or deep learning.
